prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1086
Claimant:
Carrie Hatfield
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2-19-24
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder after a collision at an intersection where the vehicle was turning left and
was struck on the driver side. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through
the attorney's office. The driver is named on the policy, and the policy was in force at the time of loss.
3-4-24
Reviewed the police report and spoke with the responding officer, who confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at
the scene. No independent witnesses have come forward, so the account rests on the parties involved and the
photographs taken at the scene. The photos confirm some of the details reported by the claimant.
3-22-24
Vehicle inspection completed. The damage is mostly consistent with the impact described by all parties. No prior
damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
5-8-24
The claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far, including the initial statement and the
follow-up call. The wrist fracture claimed is still under review, and it is not yet clear whether the injury resulted from
this crash. Medical records show the claimant was traeted for the same body area within the last two years, and that
prior condition appears to add to the current complaints.
6-29-24
Recieved medical billing and treatment notes. Treatment followed a usual course for this type of injury and tapered off
as the patient improved. Records have been rqeuested from the treating providers to clarify the timeline of the prior
condition relative to this loss.
7-11-24
File remains open pending receipt of the requested medical records and the attorney's demand package. Next review
scheduled once those documents are received and the causation question has been assessed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
